requirement: Image-only CMS adapters place sourced photos through native contract shapes and preserve editor/revision fences

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: WordPress/Joomla stopped drawing when the place had photos; EmDash did not
oracle.invariant: S1: both runs get --no-images and no image key. S2: drawing as before. S3: sourced media is uploaded and read back; text stays unchanged; replay does not upload again or repeat an acknowledged publication. S4: editor changes and unknown mutations fail closed; hidden detail routes are excluded; a later prose image change cannot pass verification. S5: the keyed WordPress inspection writes only image slots and verifies readback; both editor changes refuse replacement.
